visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white hoodie stands in a bright indoor kitchen or studio space. He holds a large black circular object encased in plastic packaging towards the camera, gesturing with his right hand as he speaks. (2) The scene cuts to a screen recording of an Instagram profile for 'fxip.official', followed by images of various colorful furniture and tech products featuring Pikachu branding. (3) The man begins unboxing a large black foam case that has 'ASTRO BOY'S SPIRIT' and a heart symbol embossed on the front. He peels off the outer plastic wrapping with his hands. (4) Inside the foam case, multiple compartments contain parts of a figurine wrapped in protective plastic. He removes a black envelope labeled 'SPECIAL GIFT' and displays three character cards and a sheet of stickers featuring Astro Boy. (5) He carefully extracts a white stylized figurine of Astro Boy with large red boots. He holds it close to the camera, touching the smooth surface to demonstrate its texture while continuing to narrate. (6) He removes a second large red boot-shaped object from the case, identifying it as a wireless charger. He shows the black circular charging interface at the top of the boot. (7) He places both the figurine and the charger on a grey surface. A woman's hands briefly enter the frame, pointing at the items as they discuss the product's appearance.
